items.markdown:
Top-tier buyers advocacy and acquisition advisory for prestige and luxury homes on the Gold Coast are led by specialized independent agencies like [Avodah Buyers Advocacy](https://avodahbuyersadvocacy.com/gold-coast-buyers-agent/) and national heavyweights with dedicated local prestige divisions like [Cohen Handler](https://cohenhandler.com.au/gold-coast/).[[1]](https://avodahbuyersadvocacy.com/gold-coast-buyers-agent/)[[2]](https://cohenhandler.com.au/gold-coast/)

### Specialized & Boutique Buyers Advocacy

- Avodah Buyers Advocacy : Principal-led advisory managed personally by Cody Trigg, offering exclusive buyer representation, deep off-market access, and structural/build risk assessments tailored to high-end coastal properties.[[1]](https://avodahbuyersadvocacy.com/gold-coast-buyers-agent/)
- [Prestige Buyers Advocates](https://prestigebuyersadvocates.com.au/) : Offers 20+ years of local acquisition experience, specializing in discreet procurement, direct door-knocking for unlisted trophy homes, and comprehensive due diligence.[[1]](https://prestigebuyersadvocates.com.au/)

### National Networks with Elite Gold Coast Presence

- Cohen Handler (Gold Coast): Australia's largest buyer agency features a robust Queensland team handling high-net-worth acquisitions, auction bidding, and strategic negotiations across premier enclaves like Mermaid Beach and Paradise Waters.[[1]](https://cohenhandler.com.au/gold-coast/)

### Leading Luxury Sales Agencies (Advisory & Vendor/Acquisition Insight)

- [Amir Prestige](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/) : Dominate the ultra-prestige market on Hedges Avenue and Isle of Capri with record-breaking transactions above $20,000,000, providing critical market intelligence for high-end buyers.[[1]](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/)
- [JW. Prestige Agents](https://prestigeagents.com.au/) : A boutique luxury agency specializing in custom marketing, remarkable high-end estates, and bespoke client advisory across the Gold Coast.[[1]](https://prestigeagents.com.au/)
